about: List prices in US dollars per million tokens, for kuwai's Usage panel's spend estimate (lib/spend.mjs). An estimate only: a subscription plan doesn't pay these. Rows are tried in order; `match` is a regular expression on the model id. A row without cacheRead / cacheWrite / cacheWrite1h takes `defaults` times its input price. A model no row matches is counted in tokens and shown without a price. To update: change a number, or add a row above a broader one. A row may name its own `source` and `asOf`; without them the file's apply.
source: Anthropic's published API list prices (first-party); other rows name their own source
